title: Windows and Active Directory security basics
description: The Active Directory changes attackers make first: privileged group changes, built-in Administrators membership, DCSync replication rights, AdminSDHolder edits, audit policy changes, cleared event logs, DSRM password resets, and GPO container changes.

requiredData.notes: Enable the Security event log input in Splunk_TA_windows on domain controllers and member servers. Advanced audit policy must log account management, directory service changes, and policy change events (4662, 4719, 4728/4732, 4794, 5136, 1102).

industrySources.control: Appendix L: events to monitor (4719, 4794 High; 1102 Medium-High)
Appendix C: protected accounts and groups, AdminSDHolder
ACSC: detecting DCSync and AD compromise

curationNotes: Skips SID History (ES-only content in cat-10), Sysmon-based detections, raw 4625 failure volume (noisy), and Defender 1116.
All eight sidecars are status draft; the Appendix L / ESCU picks are right but the sidecars are not verified.
